 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.
 
 ## Versioned export contract

 ## Verification limits
 
-Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. These tests verify the browser-local model and serialized timing; physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.
+Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. A browser test exports three real prepared files from an appended take and checks their shared zero against events, activity, scene changes and Git anchors. Physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.

+test('aligns reviewed workshop events, activity, scenes and Git anchors with prepared appended-take sources', async ({ page, baseURL }, testInfo) => {
+    await openStudio(page, baseURL);
+    await seedRecordingEditorFixture(page, { isAppendedSession: true });
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/workshops/repository/commit', async (route) => {
+        const commitId = (route.request().postDataJSON() as { lookup: { commitId: string } }).lookup.commitId;
+        await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({
+            commit: { sha: commitId, committedAt: '2026-09-28T08:20:00.000Z', message: 'Selected branch commit' },
+        }) });
+    });
+    const playhead = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Přehrávací hlava', exact: true });
+    await playhead.press('Home');
+    for (let second = 0; second < 11; second += 1) await playhead.press('ArrowRight');
+    await expect(page.getByLabel('Společný čas')).toHaveAttribute('data-session-seconds', '11');
+    const editor = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Metadata workshopu' });
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Založit metadata workshopu' }).click();
+    const activity = editor.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Aktivita' }).locator('..');
+    await activity.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rozdělit u hlavy' }).click();
+    await activity.getByLabel('Typ').nth(1).selectOption('automatic-coding');
+    await activity.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Ručně potvrzeno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat událost u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Název události').fill('Agent started unattended pass');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Zdroj application').selectOption('camera');
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Výchozí scénu jsem zkontroloval(a)' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přechod u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Zkontrolováno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Repozitář workshopu').fill('example/workshop');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Větve workshopu').fill('main');
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Uložit repozitář' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Počáteční SHA').fill('a'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a uložit' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a přidat kotvu' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText('Metadata jsou připravená k exportu.')).toBeVisible();
+    const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'ZIP s ořezem', exact: true }).click();
+    const archivePath = testInfo.outputPath('appended-workshop-metadata.zip');
+    await (await downloadPromise).saveAs(archivePath);
+    const files = await readArchive(archivePath);
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get('recording.json'))) as RecordingArchiveManifest;
+    const preparedFilename = manifest.workshopMetadata?.preparedFile;
+    if (!preparedFilename) throw new Error('Missing prepared workshop metadata');
+    const prepared = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get(preparedFilename))) as {
+        readonly preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: number;
+        readonly commitAtSelectionStart: { readonly state: string; readonly sha: string };
+        readonly events: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[];
+        readonly activityIntervals: readonly { readonly startSeconds: number; readonly endSeconds: number; readonly classification: string }[];
+        readonly autoView: { readonly transitions: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[] };
+        readonly commitAnchors: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number; readonly commit: { readonly sha: string } }[];
+    };
+    expect(manifest.tracks.filter((track) => track.trimmedFile).length).toBe(3);
+    expect(manifest.tracks.every((track) => track.preparation?.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds === 9.25)).toBe(true);
+    expect(prepared.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds).toBe(9.25);
+    expect(prepared.commitAtSelectionStart).toMatchObject({ state: 'known', sha: 'a'.repeat(40) });
+    expect(prepared.events).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.activityIntervals).toMatchObject([
+        { startSeconds: 0, endSeconds: 1.75, classification: 'unclassified' },
+        { startSeconds: 1.75, endSeconds: 5, classification: 'automatic-coding' },
+    ]);
+    expect(prepared.autoView.transitions).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.commitAnchors).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11, commit: { sha: 'b'.repeat(40) } }]);
+});

 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.

Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. These tests verify the browser-local model and serialized timing; physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.
+Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. A browser test exports three real prepared files from an appended take and checks their shared zero against events, activity, scene changes and Git anchors. Physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.

+test('aligns reviewed workshop events, activity, scenes and Git anchors with prepared appended-take sources', async ({ page, baseURL }, testInfo) => {
+    await openStudio(page, baseURL);
+    await seedRecordingEditorFixture(page, { isAppendedSession: true });
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/workshops/repository/commit', async (route) => {
+        const commitId = (route.request().postDataJSON() as { lookup: { commitId: string } }).lookup.commitId;
+        await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({
+            commit: { sha: commitId, committedAt: '2026-09-28T08:20:00.000Z', message: 'Selected branch commit' },
+        }) });
+    });
+    const playhead = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Přehrávací hlava', exact: true });
+    await playhead.press('Home');
+    for (let second = 0; second < 11; second += 1) await playhead.press('ArrowRight');
+    await expect(page.getByLabel('Společný čas')).toHaveAttribute('data-session-seconds', '11');
+    const editor = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Metadata workshopu' });
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Založit metadata workshopu' }).click();
+    const activity = editor.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Aktivita' }).locator('..');
+    await activity.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rozdělit u hlavy' }).click();
+    await activity.getByLabel('Typ').nth(1).selectOption('automatic-coding');
+    await activity.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Ručně potvrzeno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat událost u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Název události').fill('Agent started unattended pass');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Zdroj application').selectOption('camera');
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Výchozí scénu jsem zkontroloval(a)' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přechod u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Zkontrolováno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Repozitář workshopu').fill('example/workshop');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Větve workshopu').fill('main');
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Uložit repozitář' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Počáteční SHA').fill('a'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a uložit' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a přidat kotvu' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText('Metadata jsou připravená k exportu.')).toBeVisible();
+    const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'ZIP s ořezem', exact: true }).click();
+    const archivePath = testInfo.outputPath('appended-workshop-metadata.zip');
+    await (await downloadPromise).saveAs(archivePath);
+    const files = await readArchive(archivePath);
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get('recording.json'))) as RecordingArchiveManifest;
+    const preparedFilename = manifest.workshopMetadata?.preparedFile;
+    if (!preparedFilename) throw new Error('Missing prepared workshop metadata');
+    const prepared = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get(preparedFilename))) as {
+        readonly preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: number;
+        readonly commitAtSelectionStart: { readonly state: string; readonly sha: string };
+        readonly events: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[];
+        readonly activityIntervals: readonly { readonly startSeconds: number; readonly endSeconds: number; readonly classification: string }[];
+        readonly autoView: { readonly transitions: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[] };
+        readonly commitAnchors: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number; readonly commit: { readonly sha: string } }[];
+    };
+    expect(manifest.tracks.filter((track) => track.trimmedFile).length).toBe(3);
+    expect(manifest.tracks.every((track) => track.preparation?.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds === 9.25)).toBe(true);
+    expect(prepared.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds).toBe(9.25);
+    expect(prepared.commitAtSelectionStart).toMatchObject({ state: 'known', sha: 'a'.repeat(40) });
+    expect(prepared.events).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.activityIntervals).toMatchObject([
+        { startSeconds: 0, endSeconds: 1.75, classification: 'unclassified' },
+        { startSeconds: 1.75, endSeconds: 5, classification: 'automatic-coding' },
+    ]);
+    expect(prepared.autoView.transitions).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.commitAnchors).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11, commit: { sha: 'b'.repeat(40) } }]);
+});

 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.

+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));

 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.
 
 ## Versioned export contract
 
@@ -26,4 +26,4 @@
 
 ## Verification limits
 
-Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. These tests verify the browser-local model and serialized timing; physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.
+Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. A browser test exports three real prepared files from an appended take and checks their shared zero against events, activity, scene changes and Git anchors. +    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přechod u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Zkontrolováno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Repozitář workshopu').fill('example/workshop');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Větve workshopu').fill('main');
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Uložit repozitář' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Počáteční SHA').fill('a'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a uložit' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a přidat kotvu' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText('Metadata jsou připravená k exportu.')).toBeVisible();

 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.

+test('aligns reviewed workshop events, activity, scenes and Git anchors with prepared appended-take sources', async ({ page, baseURL }, testInfo) => {
+    await openStudio(page, baseURL);
+    await seedRecordingEditorFixture(page, { isAppendedSession: true });
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/workshops/repository/commit', async (route) => {
+        const commitId = (route.request().postDataJSON() as { lookup: { commitId: string } }).lookup.commitId;
+        await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({
+            commit: { sha: commitId, committedAt: '2026-09-28T08:20:00.000Z', message: 'Selected branch commit' },
+        }) });
+    });
+    const playhead = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Přehrávací hlava', exact: true });
+    await playhead.press('Home');
+    for (let second = 0; second < 11; second += 1) await playhead.press('ArrowRight');
+    await expect(page.getByLabel('Společný čas')).toHaveAttribute('data-session-seconds', '11');
+    const editor = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Metadata workshopu' });
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Založit metadata workshopu' }).click();
+    const activity = editor.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Aktivita' }).locator('..');
+    await activity.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rozdělit u hlavy' }).click();
+    await activity.getByLabel('Typ').nth(1).selectOption('automatic-coding');
+    await activity.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Ručně potvrzeno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat událost u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Název události').fill('Agent started unattended pass');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Zdroj application').selectOption('camera');
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Výchozí scénu jsem zkontroloval(a)' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přechod u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Zkontrolováno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Repozitář workshopu').fill('example/workshop');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Větve workshopu').fill('main');
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Uložit repozitář' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Počáteční SHA').fill('a'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a uložit' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a přidat kotvu' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText('Metadata jsou připravená k exportu.')).toBeVisible();
+    const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'ZIP s ořezem', exact: true }).click();
+    const archivePath = testInfo.outputPath('appended-workshop-metadata.zip');
+    await (await downloadPromise).saveAs(archivePath);
+    const files = await readArchive(archivePath);
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get('recording.json'))) as RecordingArchiveManifest;
+    const preparedFilename = manifest.workshopMetadata?.preparedFile;
+    if (!preparedFilename) throw new Error('Missing prepared workshop metadata');
+    const prepared = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get(preparedFilename))) as {
+        readonly preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: number;
+        readonly commitAtSelectionStart: { readonly state: string; readonly sha: string };
+        readonly events: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[];
+        readonly activityIntervals: readonly { readonly startSeconds: number; readonly endSeconds: number; readonly classification: string }[];
+        readonly autoView: { readonly transitions: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[] };
+        readonly commitAnchors: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number; readonly commit: { readonly sha: string } }[];
+    };
+    expect(manifest.tracks.filter((track) => track.trimmedFile).length).toBe(3);
+    expect(manifest.tracks.every((track) => track.preparation?.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds === 9.25)).toBe(true);
+    expect(prepared.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds).toBe(9.25);
+    expect(prepared.commitAtSelectionStart).toMatchObject({ state: 'known', sha: 'a'.repeat(40) });
+    expect(prepared.events).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.activityIntervals).toMatchObject([
+        { startSeconds: 0, endSeconds: 1.75, classification: 'unclassified' },
+        { startSeconds: 1.75, endSeconds: 5, classification: 'automatic-coding' },
+    ]);
+    expect(prepared.autoView.transitions).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.commitAnchors).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11, commit: { sha: 'b'.repeat(40) } }]);
+});

   independent event markers, validated Auto-view scene choices, repository/start SHA and reviewed commit anchors.
   Speech suggests boundaries only; unclassified gaps stay at 1× and never become automatic coding from silence.

   report stale source revisions. This is local metadata for a later player, not published media or visible transcript
   subtitles. Design and limits are documented in `docs/recording-studio-workshop-metadata.md`.

 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.
 
 ## Versioned export contract

It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. These tests verify the browser-local model and serialized timing; physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.
+Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. A browser test exports three real prepared files from an appended take and checks their shared zero against events, activity, scene changes and Git anchors. Physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.

+test('aligns reviewed workshop events, activity, scenes and Git anchors with prepared appended-take sources', async ({ page, baseURL }, testInfo) => {
+    await openStudio(page, baseURL);
+    await seedRecordingEditorFixture(page, { isAppendedSession: true });
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/workshops/repository/commit', async (route) => {
+        const commitId = (route.request().postDataJSON() as { lookup: { commitId: string } }).lookup.commitId;
+        await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({
+            commit: { sha: commitId, committedAt: '2026-09-28T08:20:00.000Z', message: 'Selected branch commit' },
+        }) });
+    });
+    const playhead = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Přehrávací hlava', exact: true });
+    await playhead.press('Home');
+    for (let second = 0; second < 11; second += 1) await playhead.press('ArrowRight');
+    await expect(page.getByLabel('Společný čas')).toHaveAttribute('data-session-seconds', '11');
+    const editor = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Metadata workshopu' });
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Založit metadata workshopu' }).click();
+    const activity = editor.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Aktivita' }).locator('..');
+    await activity.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rozdělit u hlavy' }).click();
+    await activity.getByLabel('Typ').nth(1).selectOption('automatic-coding');
+    await activity.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Ručně potvrzeno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat událost u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Název události').fill('Agent started unattended pass');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Zdroj application').selectOption('camera');
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Výchozí scénu jsem zkontroloval(a)' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přechod u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Zkontrolováno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Repozitář workshopu').fill('example/workshop');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Větve workshopu').fill('main');
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Uložit repozitář' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Počáteční SHA').fill('a'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a uložit' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a přidat kotvu' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText('Metadata jsou připravená k exportu.')).toBeVisible();
+    const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'ZIP s ořezem', exact: true }).click();
+    const archivePath = testInfo.outputPath('appended-workshop-metadata.zip');
+    await (await downloadPromise).saveAs(archivePath);
+    const files = await readArchive(archivePath);
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get('recording.json'))) as RecordingArchiveManifest;
+    const preparedFilename = manifest.workshopMetadata?.preparedFile;
+    if (!preparedFilename) throw new Error('Missing prepared workshop metadata');
+    const prepared = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get(preparedFilename))) as {
+        readonly preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: number;
+        readonly commitAtSelectionStart: { readonly state: string; readonly sha: string };
+        readonly events: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[];
+        readonly activityIntervals: readonly { readonly startSeconds: number; readonly endSeconds: number; readonly classification: string }[];
+        readonly autoView: { readonly transitions: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number }[] };
+        readonly commitAnchors: readonly { readonly seconds: number; readonly originalSeconds: number; readonly commit: { readonly sha: string } }[];
+    };
+    expect(manifest.tracks.filter((track) => track.trimmedFile).length).toBe(3);
+    expect(manifest.tracks.every((track) => track.preparation?.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds === 9.25)).toBe(true);
+    expect(prepared.preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds).toBe(9.25);
+    expect(prepared.commitAtSelectionStart).toMatchObject({ state: 'known', sha: 'a'.repeat(40) });
+    expect(prepared.events).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.activityIntervals).toMatchObject([
+        { startSeconds: 0, endSeconds: 1.75, classification: 'unclassified' },
+        { startSeconds: 1.75, endSeconds: 5, classification: 'automatic-coding' },
+    ]);
+    expect(prepared.autoView.transitions).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11 }]);
+    expect(prepared.commitAnchors).toMatchObject([{ seconds: 1.75, originalSeconds: 11, commit: { sha: 'b'.repeat(40) } }]);
+});

 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references; a missing or rebased commit becomes `unavailable`, and lookup at or after that anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. With no reliable mapping, lookup is `unknown`. It never creates a SHA from a date.
+The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. The editor can recheck saved SHA references. A failed provider check becomes `unverified`, so playback reports `unknown` rather than claiming that GitHub proved a commit missing; after confirming a missing or rebased commit, the editor can explicitly mark it `unavailable`. Lookup at or after an unavailable anchor reports unavailable until another reviewed anchor takes over. Before the first anchor, the starting commit applies. It never creates a SHA from a date.
 
-Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check time; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes or GitHub outages.
+Automatic proposals require an explicit calibration pair: a recorded-content session second and an ISO wall-clock timestamp with an offset or `Z`. The authenticated proposal endpoint reads only actual commits from the selected branches within the calibrated window, with bounded pages and count. Their commit timestamps suggest positions; proposals are stored unreviewed until an editor checks each against the recording. One calibration cannot account for a pause or a later appended take, so its proposed times are especially approximate across those boundaries; the editor must move or discard them after review. The UI calls out timezone, clock skew, delayed pushes, rebases and uncommitted work. A truncated feed reports that its proposal list is incomplete. Start/anchor availability records the last check attempt; rechecking before publication is the operator's way to detect later branch changes.

Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. These tests verify the browser-local model and serialized timing; physical capture timing and the accuracy of commit dates still require review against the actual workshop recording.
+Unit coverage uses two video sources, independently playable parts, a global pause and an appended take. It checks clip/rebase alignment, manual interval operations, speech suggestions without inferred coding, scene gaps, stale revision reporting and commit lookup around anchors. Archive tests check schema and sidecar inclusion. A browser test exports three real prepared files from an appended take and checks their shared zero against events, activity, scene changes and Git anchors. diff --git a/docs/recording-studio-workshop-metadata.md b/docs/recording-studio-workshop-metadata.md
index f0acc87955fe1d0829c9bccb15569b1ed9c110b4..2059f0209a6002b9be777d6ae6571fa6bc2eb4ca
--- a/docs/recording-studio-workshop-metadata.md
+++ b/docs/recording-studio-workshop-metadata.md
@@ -6,17 +6,17 @@
 
 ## Local editing and review
 
-`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
+`StudioRecording.workshopMetadata` is an optional browser-local revision of workshop annotations. Existing recordings remain readable without it. The editor creates it explicitly and autosaves it through the same protected recording edit. Both IndexedDB and selected-directory checkpoints retain the complete metadata on reload or read-only folder import. Manual changes survive transcript or voice activity regeneration because those tracks remain separate. An appended take extends the activity coverage with an unclassified range and makes the saved source revision stale; the editor keeps earlier work and offers explicit revision review.
 
 Activity intervals use half-open original session ranges, never overlap, and cover the selected export. The initial full-session interval is `unclassified`. Splitting, moving a shared boundary, merging and reclassifying are non-destructive. A speech track can split unclassified ranges at detected speech boundaries but assigns no playback class. In particular, silence and uncertain audio never imply `automatic-coding`. That class requires an explicit review checkbox; unclassified time has a specified 1× playback rate. Event markers have a title, optional type/detail and independent time. Editing their times sorts them; they never alter media, activity or subtitle cues.
 
-Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured media ranges. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
+Auto-view stores a default `editor` or `application` scene and reviewed transition points. Each scene names one of the original video source IDs. Validation checks that the chosen source covers the entire selected scene span using the existing source segment and measured video-component ranges; an audio-only part does not count as a valid picture. A missing source or gap blocks workshop metadata export; the original source files remain independent and Auto-view never changes them.
 
 ## Git association and calibration
 
-The editor stores the repository identity, selected branch patterns and a verified 40-character starting SHA. Manual anchors resolve through the existing authenticated workshop commit lookup, which checks the selected branches. +test('aligns reviewed workshop events, activity, scenes and Git anchors with prepared appended-take sources', async ({ page, baseURL }, testInfo) => {
+    await openStudio(page, baseURL);
+    await seedRecordingEditorFixture(page, { isAppendedSession: true });
+    await page.route('**/api/admin/workshops/repository/commit', async (route) => {
+        const commitId = (route.request().postDataJSON() as { lookup: { commitId: string } }).lookup.commitId;
+        await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({
+            commit: { sha: commitId, committedAt: '2026-09-28T08:20:00.000Z', message: 'Selected branch commit' },
+        }) });
+    });
+    const playhead = page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Přehrávací hlava', exact: true });
+    await playhead.press('Home');
+    for (let second = 0; second < 11; second += 1) await playhead.press('ArrowRight');
+    await expect(page.getByLabel('Společný čas')).toHaveAttribute('data-session-seconds', '11');
+    const editor = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Metadata workshopu' });
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Založit metadata workshopu' }).click();
+    const activity = editor.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Aktivita' }).locator('..');
+    await activity.getByRole('button', { name: 'Rozdělit u hlavy' }).click();
+    await activity.getByLabel('Typ').nth(1).selectOption('automatic-coding');
+    await activity.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Ručně potvrzeno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat událost u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Název události').fill('Agent started unattended pass');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Zdroj application').selectOption('camera');
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Výchozí scénu jsem zkontroloval(a)' }).check();
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přechod u hlavy' }).click();
+    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Zkontrolováno' }).check();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Repozitář workshopu').fill('example/workshop');
+    await editor.getByLabel('Větve workshopu').fill('main');
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Uložit repozitář' }).click();
+    await editor.getByLabel('Počáteční SHA').fill('a'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a uložit' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText(/Počáteční commit:/)).toBeVisible();
+    await editor.getByLabel('SHA nové kotvy').fill('b'.repeat(40));
+    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ověřit a přidat kotvu' }).click();
+    await expect(editor.getByText('Metadata jsou připravená k exportu.')).toBeVisible();
+    const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'ZIP s ořezem', exact: true }).click();
+    const archivePath = testInfo.outputPath('appended-workshop-metadata.zip');
+    await (await downloadPromise).saveAs(archivePath);
+    const files = await readArchive(archivePath);
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get('recording.json'))) as RecordingArchiveManifest;
+    const preparedFilename = manifest.workshopMetadata?.preparedFile;
+    if (!preparedFilename) throw new Error('Missing prepared workshop metadata');
+    const prepared = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(files.get(preparedFilename))) as {
+        readonly preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: number;
+        readonly commitAtSelectionStart: { readonly state: string; readonly sha: string };
